{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_dup_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False).sum()

# Check how many unique patients and total rows
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()
total_rows = len(df)

# Check sample_seq to see if there are multiple entries per patient
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Count how many patients have multiple sample_seq entries
retested_patients = sample_seq_max[sample_seq_max > 1].count()

patient_dup_count, unique_patients, total_rows, retested_patients"}
